/* AUDIO THÉRAPIE — module d'ambiance indépendant */
.ambience-widget{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:87px;z-index:55;width:min(325px,calc(100vw - 28px));border:1px solid #8c7045;border-radius:13px;background:#17130eeF;box-shadow:0 14px 45px #000b;color:#eee0c8;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.ambience-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 10px}
.ambience-play{flex:none;min-width:78px;border:1px solid #dbbc87;background:#d4ad70;color:#20180d;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 10px;min-height:36px}
.ambience-play:hover{background:#efd2a1}
.ambience-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.ambience-copy strong{display:block;color:#f2ddb7;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.11em}.ambience-copy small{font-size:10px;color:#aca08b;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ambience-more{background:#2c261e;color:#e8d4b3;border:1px solid #685638;border-radius:7px;min-width:32px;min-height:32px;padding:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.ambience-controls{padding:0 13px 13px;border-top:1px solid #423521}
.ambience-controls[hidden]{display:none!important}.ambience-controls label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;margin:9px 0 4px;gap:15px}.ambience-controls input{width:100%;accent-color:#d4ad70;height:25px}.ambience-controls p{font-size:10px;color:#aa9b86;margin:5px 0 0;line-height:1.45}
body[data-page="ecoute"] .ambience-widget{bottom:104px}
@media(max-width:760px){.ambience-widget{right:12px;bottom:132px;width:min(305px,calc(100vw - 24px))}body[data-page="ecoute"] .ambience-widget{bottom:202px}.ambience-top{padding:7px 8px}.ambience-controls{padding:0 9px 9px}}
@media print{.ambience-widget{display:none!important}}
